text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to reconcile two places pulling different names for the same concepts: docs/glossary.md and sdk/TERMS.md. Items to resolve: 'model revision' vs 'version', 'dedicated capacity' vs 'reserved', 'private deployment' vs 'private runtime'. Also some SDK migration snippets reference old param names. I'm proposing a small lexicon-first PR that (1) chooses canonical terms, (2) adds a mapping table in the glossary, (3) runs automated snippet update for SDK examples. @Josh can you confirm snippet change impact? PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :sparkles:

Josh: Saw this — SDK currently uses `model_version` in Python and `modelTag` in JS. I'm open to switching to `model_revision` if we standardize. Snippet patch idea: replace `client.generate(model="gpt-3.5")` with `client.generate(model_id="redwood/gpt-3.5")`. Example:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
c.generate(model_id="redwood/gpt-4-mini", prompt="Hello")
```
Will run snippet tests if we lock term.

Anita: +1 for a mapping table. Also flag: internal docs and API changelog need to list deprecated terms with dates. Can we add redirect links for old glossary anchors?

Tim: Suggest canonical terms: `model_id` (single token), `dedicated` (keep user-facing), `private` for deployment type. But list both synonyms in mapping. We should avoid breaking public SDKs — use aliases in SDKs for 2 minor releases.

Lili: I can take the PR and coordinate SDK change. Plan: 1) update glossary/lexicon with the mapping table 2) run `scripts/sync_snippets.sh` to collect affected examples 3) open companion PR in sdk repo with alias layer 4) update migration guide with a 'renaming matrix'. Target merge by Thu EOD. Volunteers: @Josh for SDK PR, @Anita for redirect pages, @Tim for final API wording.

Josh: I'll add the alias layer — won't break existing calls. Also will add runtime deprecation warning in logs when old param used.

Maya: Nice. Checklist for PR: 
- [ ] glossary mapping table
- [ ] automated snippet search/replace (CI should fail if leftover)
- [ ] migration guide section with code before/after
- [ ] redirect anchors for old glossary terms
- [ ] SDK alias + integration tests
- [ ] update release notes and changelog
Assign owners in PR description.

docs-bot: Preview for PR #842 published: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/lexicon-842 — run `npm run snippet-test` to validate.

Lili: Thanks all — I'll open the PR in an hour and ping here when ready. If no objections by 5pm PT I'll merge and coordinate SDK PR rollout.
